newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Gas Vision sees good prospects for AGA, ASG.
newsitem.headline: Gas Vision sees good prospects for AGA, ASG.

text.p: Swiss financial holding company Gas Vision AG said it it saw good medium-term prospects for AGA AB and ASG AB as the industrial gas sector meets growing demand.
"Medium-term earnings prospects for all the companies in Gas Vision's portfolio are still good," it said in an annual report.

"Thanks to extensive investments, AGA is well placed to benefit from the worldwide increase in the demand for industrial gas. Profit increases can be expected over the next few years, 1996 was a transitional year," it said.

"ASG will also be facing a difficult environment in the next few years, The ASG management is meeting these challenges with restructurings and improved services in an attempt to achieve a sustained increase in profitability. These efforts are already paying off in some sectors."
At the end of 1996, Gas Vision held a 19.3 percent stake in AGA, representing 21.2 percent of voting rights. It held 26.9 percent of ASG, or 15.4 percent of the votes.
